title: Herbaceous Tunisian Bryndza Skillet
description: A smoky, velvety skillet dish that marries creamy bryndza cheese with fresh herbs and quinoa in a succulent Tunisian twist.
instructions: Preheat a cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Drizzle 1 tbsp of olive oil in the skillet and let it heat until shimmering.
Add 150g of bryndza cheese to the skillet, breaking it into bite‑sized pieces.
Sprinkle 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp ground cumin over the cheese and stir to coat evenly.
Sauté the mixture for 3 minutes until the cheese begins to soften and the spices release aroma.
Fold in 200g of cooked quinoa, 1/2 sliced red bell pepper, 2 tbsp chopped fresh coriander, and 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley.
Season with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp lemon zest, and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and stir gently to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 5 minutes to meld flavors and melt the cheese completely.
Remove the skillet from heat and sprinkle 1 tsp fresh mint leaves for a burst of freshness.
Serve the skillet directly from the cast‑iron pan, accompanied by crusty grain bread or a side salad.
